lines.speaker: RADIO
lines.text: Multiple explosions across Old Market. Power is failing. The main clinic road is blocked.

lines.speaker: RADIO
lines.text: Joint Response Command, respond. The district relay is down. The command channel is silent.

lines.speaker: DALIA
lines.text: Major Dalia Rahim, J R C field command. Convoy survivors located. Extraction is underway.

lines.speaker: SAMIRA
lines.text: Engineer Samira Haddad, civil infrastructure. Families and road crews are trapped beyond the clinic route.

lines.speaker: ARIA
lines.text: I am ARIA, the Civic Relay assistant. Relay integrity is partial. Command channels are offline.

lines.speaker: ARIA
lines.text: Emergency continuity protocol active. One valid command authority remains.

lines.speaker: ARIA
lines.text: Old Market is the immediate priority. Armed movement is closing on the blocked clinic route.

lines.speaker: ARIA
lines.text: Commander identity confirmed. I will advise. Authority remains yours.

lines.speaker: ARIA
lines.text: This was coordinated. Power, roads, and command failed in sequence.

lines.speaker: DALIA
lines.text: Two J R C squads are still responding. The nearest forward post is dark.

lines.speaker: SAMIRA
lines.text: Civilians, clinic staff, and municipal crews remain behind the closure.

lines.speaker: ARIA
lines.text: The pattern suggests coordination. Attribution is not yet reliable.

lines.speaker: COMMANDER
lines.text: Connect the response. Protect the clinic corridor. Confirm targets before engagement.

lines.speaker: DALIA
lines.text: Confirmed armed Ash Line patrol approaching Old Market. No heavy weapons observed.

lines.speaker: ARIA
lines.text: Three armed hostiles confirmed. Civilians remain behind the barriers. Keep fire inside the marked corridor.

lines.speaker: DALIA
lines.text: Field units are ready. Tactical control is yours, Commander.

lines.speaker: ARIA
lines.text: Select the rifle squad. Move to cover. Secure the corridor.
